usage.callShape: GET https://api.x402node.dev/text/keywords?text=<URL-encoded text> (x402 payment, ~0.0022 USDC on Base)

inputExample.text: Machine learning models extract keywords from natural language text using statistical methods

usage.outputShape: body.keywords[] (each {word, count}), plus body.language, body.total_tokens, body.unique_keywords, body.text_length, body.processing_ms
quirks: Registry surface lists this as Free/priceAmount 0, but it is actually a PAID x402 endpoint: returns 402 and charges 0.0022 USDC (paymentAccepts amount 2200 on Base). Treat as paid.
It is a GET request: pass the input text in the ?text= query string (URL-encoded), NOT a JSON body.
Output keywords are simple word-frequency counts ({word,count}), not weighted/semantic phrases.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.x402node.dev/text/keywords with your text URL-encoded into the ?text= query parameter (e.g. ?text=Machine+learning...). Pay via x402 on Base; cost is about 0.0022 USDC per call despite the registry showing it as Free. The response is plain sync JSON; read the extracted keywords from body.keywords[] where each entry is {word, count}, with totals in body.unique_keywords / body.total_tokens and detected body.language.
